# skwire

> The universal bootstrapper / wiring fabric. Talk to it, it asks a few questions, then "want me to just do it?" — heck yeah — and it mints every secret, wires every connection, and keeps your keys rotated. For humans and AI agents alike.

skwire turns descriptors (what each thing provides + needs) into a Plan, mints every secret up front, injects them, pushes cross-service config, and brokers a hash-bound approval. Pure-stdlib core, zero deps, cross-platform, embeddable in any project. Ships a slick branded chat window (no terminal) and an app-store catalog of best-of-breed open source — install, use, then have the AI help you contribute or fork your own.
